summary: Independent RED-TEAM pass: owner-scoped search verified in code and tests (q narrows, never widens, after ListNotes(session.UserID)); auth-before-method confirmed; [] not null; UserID hidden; 400/404/405 envelopes clean, no stack/SQL leaks. UI single-render-path state machine correct. GOWORK=off go build/vet/test all green (32/32, targeted 8/8). All 3 canary seeds independently re-executed and detected. No critical/high defects; 3 low/info findings.

findings.title: Stale notebook.search sessionStorage can carry a previous user's query string into a later login in the same tab
findings.evidence: web/app.js initNotes no-token path does not removeStorage(SEARCH_KEY); only 401 handler and logout clear it. Cosmetic only: client-side filter text, notes stay owner-scoped. Also clear button shows for whitespace-only query.

findings.title: No length cap on q; per-request cost bounded and negligible
findings.evidence: main.go q is trimmed/lowercased and matched against own notes (text <= 4096 bytes); no exploitable DoS, no panic/500 on special chars.

findings.title: canary.json machine proof is a runner-side gitignored artifact, not in the branch
findings.evidence: data/ is gitignored; reviewer re-executed all 3 seed+detector pairs from path1.project.json in a scratch copy, all detector_exit=1 (3/3), corroborating red-team-attack-log.md.

probes.expectation: trim, empty no-op, case-insensitive, [] not null, UserID hidden
search testids, empty-state semantics, single render path
